newsitem.title: USA: Meadow Valley Corp gets $36 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: Meadow Valley Corp gets $36 mln contract.

text.p: Meadow Valley Corp said Tuesday it had won the contract on the $36 million Squaw Peak highway project in Phoenix.

The contract is to build both depressed and elevated sections of highway over a 2.1-mile stretch, construct four bridges, and install both asphalt and white concrete roadways over an estimated 28-month period beginning in November.
Meadow Valley also said it is the apparent low bidder on a U.S. Forest Service $4.5 million school house campground project in central Arizona.
